dialogues.jp:
何となく、などと言いつつ学園に来たものの、
当然のようにやる事がない。
dialogues.en:
As expected, once I actually hit school, I quickly found
that there was nothing for sometone like me to do.
dialogues.text:
As expected, once I actually hit school, I quickly found
that there was nothing for sometone like me to do.

dialogues.en: "Bored..."
dialogues.text: "Bored..."

dialogues.jp:
忙しげに立ち回っている学生達の姿を、ぼんや
りと追う。何だか、水槽の魚になった気分。
dialogues.en:
I cast my gaze on the students scurrying back and forth.
They looked like fish in a water tank.
dialogues.text:
I cast my gaze on the students scurrying back and forth.
They looked like fish in a water tank.

dialogues.jp:
こんなに手持ち｛ぶさた／無沙汰｝だと、さすがに寂しくな
る。家に帰って、寝ようかな……。
dialogues.en:
Nothing for me to do here, I should just go home and
sleep...
dialogues.text:
Nothing for me to do here, I should just go home and
sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「よう、朝倉。こんな時に椅子にぬぼっと座っ
　てるなんざ、お前も奇特な奴だなあ」
dialogues.en:
"Yo, Asakura. Sitting, so filled with inactivity, in your
chair like that, you're a model student for the entire
student body."
dialogues.text:
"Yo, Asakura. Sitting, so filled with inactivity, in your
chair like that, you're a model student for the entire
student body."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そういうお前は、ニカニカとして楽しそうだ
　な、コノヤロ」
dialogues.en:
"You're no better, standing there grinning like a stupid
idiot."
dialogues.text:
"You're no better, standing there grinning like a stupid
idiot."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おう。こんな時こそ暗躍しないで、何が学生
　生活かっ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I'm stealthily manouvering through the hallways,
carrying out my observations of student life."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I'm stealthily manouvering through the hallways,
carrying out my observations of student life."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、暗躍はせんだろ」
dialogues.en: "No you're not."
dialogues.text: "No you're not."

dialogues.jp: 冷静にツッコミを入れる。
dialogues.en: I played the straight guy to perfection.
dialogues.text: I played the straight guy to perfection.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前、窓際族みたいに椅子で背中丸めてい
　るぐらいだったら、何か参加したらどうな
　んだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Why are you just sitting there like some deadbeat anyway?
Why don't you go help in the events if you have nothing to
do?"
dialogues.text:
"Why are you just sitting there like some deadbeat anyway?
Why don't you go help in the events if you have nothing to
do?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何かって言われてもな……」
dialogues.en: "Don't feel like it..."
dialogues.text: "Don't feel like it..."

dialogues.jp: 今さら……という感が強い。
dialogues.en: That's how I feel now, anyway...
dialogues.text: That's how I feel now, anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何だったら、こっちの企画に、一口参加させ
　てやってもいいぞ」
dialogues.en: "Or you could help me with my project."
dialogues.text: "Or you could help me with my project."

dialogues.jp: にやっと笑う。俺は、面倒臭そうに手を振った。
dialogues.en: One of THOSE smiles. I waved my hand at him, bothered.
dialogues.text: One of THOSE smiles. I waved my hand at him, bothered.

dialogues.jp: 「帰って、ベッドに潜り込んだ方がまだマシだ」
dialogues.en: "I'd rather be home and snug in my bed."
dialogues.text: "I'd rather be home and snug in my bed."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前が参加するなら心強かったんだが……強
　制はすまい。命あってのものだねだからな」
dialogues.en:
"Your participation would make the success of the project
guaranteed. You have an obligation to do so, with your life
if needed."
dialogues.text:
"Your participation would make the success of the project
guaranteed. You have an obligation to do so, with your life
if needed."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「一体お前は何をするつもりなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Just what kind of project is this?"
dialogues.text: "Just what kind of project is this?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「トップシークレットだ」
dialogues.en: "Top Secret."
dialogues.text: "Top Secret."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そういやお前、最近、白河ことりと仲いいん
　だって？」
dialogues.en:
"Lately, you've been pretty friendly with Shirakawa Kotori,
haven't you?"
dialogues.text:
"Lately, you've been pretty friendly with Shirakawa Kotori,
haven't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: ".......? What's that supposed to mean?"
dialogues.text: ".......? What's that supposed to mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だもナンも、そのままの意味だ」
dialogues.en: "It meant exactly what I said."
dialogues.text: "It meant exactly what I said."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺と、ことりが……？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori, and me...?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori, and me...?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「白河ことりに関してはかなり確実な噂を聞い
　ていたんだがな」
dialogues.en:
"The matters concerning Shirakawa Kotori would gain far more
credence if they come from you, now."
dialogues.text:
"The matters concerning Shirakawa Kotori would gain far more
credence if they come from you, now."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だよ、確実な噂って」
dialogues.en: "What are you trying to say."
dialogues.text: "What are you trying to say."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「白河ことりの隣に立つに相応しい男って、ど
　んな男だと思う？」
dialogues.en:
"What do you think are characteristics that a man would need
to be suitable for Kotori?"
dialogues.text:
"What do you think are characteristics that a man would need
to be suitable for Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ことりの隣か……」
dialogues.en: "Suitable for Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "Suitable for Kotori..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、そんじょそこらの男じゃ駄目だろうな」
dialogues.en: "It's practically impossible for someone to be that."
dialogues.text: "It's practically impossible for someone to be that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「で、だ。そのそんじょそこらの男ではない男
　が、今、風見学園にはいるだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, then apparently there's a man in this school who
makes the impossible possible, no?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, then apparently there's a man in this school who
makes the impossible possible, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いるか？」
dialogues.en: "There is?"
dialogues.text: "There is?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……まぁ、男になんか興味ないだろうから、
　知らなくてもいい話だがな」
dialogues.en:
"...Well, if she wasn't interested in any men around, that
would be good news for a lot of people."
dialogues.text:
"...Well, if she wasn't interested in any men around, that
would be good news for a lot of people."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が言う。
dialogues.en: Suginami continued talking.
dialogues.text: Suginami continued talking.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……だが、そんな噂をはねのける、ホットな
　噂を俺は入手したわけだ」
dialogues.en:
"...And relating to that, I've recently obtained the latest
gossip regarding Shirakawa Kotori."
dialogues.text:
"...And relating to that, I've recently obtained the latest
gossip regarding Shirakawa Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だよ、それ」
dialogues.en: "Which is?"
dialogues.text: "Which is?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝、学園に来る時、やたらと親しげに、白河
　ことりがお前の名前を呼んだとか呼ばないと
　か」
dialogues.en:
"This morning, you were found heading to school with
Shirakawa Kotori."
dialogues.text:
"This morning, you were found heading to school with
Shirakawa Kotori."

dialogues.jp: 早速かよ。
dialogues.en: That was quick.
dialogues.text: That was quick.

dialogues.speaker: Sugianmi
dialogues.jp:
「しかも、そのまま手を繋いで、どこか繁華街
　の方へ消えていったって話だ」
dialogues.en:
"And later, both of you were holding hands and disappeared
into the shopping district while talking."
dialogues.text:
"And later, both of you were holding hands and disappeared
into the shopping district while talking."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……とすると、今ここに居るお前は何者？　
　コピーロボット？」
dialogues.en: "...In other words, who are you? A robot clone?"
dialogues.text: "...In other words, who are you? A robot clone?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「知るか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you found out."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you found out."

dialogues.jp: やくたいもないお言葉に、頭がきりきりと痛む。
dialogues.en: His completely idiotic words made my head hurt.
dialogues.text: His completely idiotic words made my head hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前、暇なら、音楽室にでも行ったらどう
　だ？」
dialogues.en: "If you're bored, why don't you go to the music room?"
dialogues.text: "If you're bored, why don't you go to the music room?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あん？」
dialogues.en: "Ahn?"
dialogues.text: "Ahn?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「これも噂になっているが、白河とその友人達
　が何かをやっているらしいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I've heard that Shirakawa and her friends were doing
something there."
dialogues.text:
"I've heard that Shirakawa and her friends were doing
something there."

dialogues.jp: 確かに、家に帰って寝るよりは倍はマシだろう。
dialogues.en:
Well, the chances of me going home and sleeping are twice as
small,
dialogues.text:
Well, the chances of me going home and sleeping are twice as
small,

dialogues.jp:
ここでぼうっとしているよりは４倍マシで、杉
並の相手をしているよりは、２５６倍マシだ。
dialogues.en:
The chances of me staying here, four times as small, and the
chances of me wanting to talk with Suginami more was 256
times as small.
dialogues.text:
The chances of me staying here, four times as small, and the
chances of me wanting to talk with Suginami more was 256
times as small.

dialogues.jp:
「お前も、天文学的数字の確率で、たまにはい
　い事言うな」
dialogues.en:
"Against all logical odds, you've actually managed to
suggest something good."
dialogues.text:
"Against all logical odds, you've actually managed to
suggest something good."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「はっはっは。お前が、俺の｛げんせつ／言説｝の意図を理解
　出来る確率が、天文学的数字なのだ」
dialogues.en:
"Ha ha ha, there's a reason why I suggested that, it's all
written in the stars."
dialogues.text:
"Ha ha ha, there's a reason why I suggested that, it's all
written in the stars."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はっはっは」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha ha."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha ha."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はっはっは」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha ha."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha ha."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……むなしい」
dialogues.en: "...This is stupid."
dialogues.text: "...This is stupid."

dialogues.jp: 笑い疲れ、鞄を手に立ち上がった。
dialogues.en: Tired of fake laughter, I sling my bag onto my shoulder.
dialogues.text: Tired of fake laughter, I sling my bag onto my shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「帰るのか？」
dialogues.en: "Going home?"
dialogues.text: "Going home?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、とりあえずは、音楽室に行ってみる」
dialogues.en: "Nah, going to the music room."
dialogues.text: "Nah, going to the music room."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ま、頑張れや」
dialogues.en: "Then good luck."
dialogues.text: "Then good luck."

dialogues.jp: にやっと笑う杉並に、俺は肩をすくめてみせた。
dialogues.en: Suginami grinned widely, patting my shoulder.
dialogues.text: Suginami grinned widely, patting my shoulder.

dialogues.jp: 「何をだっての……」
dialogues.en: "What the hell are you talking about..."
dialogues.text: "What the hell are you talking about..."

dialogues.jp: ◆音楽室へ◆
dialogues.en: ◆To the Music Room◆
dialogues.text: ◆To the Music Room◆

dialogues.jp: 暇である。
dialogues.en: Boredom.
dialogues.text: Boredom.

dialogues.jp:
俺はやはり、ことりの練習風景を見に行く事に
した。
dialogues.en:
In the end, I decided to see Kotori's practice session in
the music room.
dialogues.text:
In the end, I decided to see Kotori's practice session in
the music room.
